source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: One county site added (James Dykes Memorial Park, Bleckley County's free Ocmulgee River landing, where a county ordinance permits RV camping) plus two non-local misses the pass surfaced: Georgia Mountain Fairgrounds (nonprofit, 207 sites on Lake Chatuge) and Stone Mountain Park Campground (state authority, Aramark-run, 400+ sites). Excluded: Mile Branch Park (tent/overnight parking), Holliday Park (long-term stays), the stale State Line Park row. About 40 private RV parks are unmatched.
